notes.title: Arena Fight Mode and Avatar Customization
notes.content:
[u]Arena Fight Mode[/u]

Bigger Space: The play area is expanded to the maximum play space of 5m by 5m for those who can afford the space (4x4m minimum works too) For those without the minimum play area, fret not as you can turn on the locomotion controls in the options to move around if you have your vr legs.

Food and Magic Claw:  The claw drops food and magic balls as it moves around the arena area. Grab the drop items as they drop down and unleash your food throwing skills or time your magic ball usage to deal damage to your opponent.

Free for all: All players start with 100 health and each hit deals 1 damage to the health. Player with the most health at the end of time wins!

https://youtu.be/UmSiSaZ36qs

[u]Avatar Customization[/u]

In the Main Menu scene where you host/join game, there is now a mirror to see your avatar and buttons to customize your look! Change your gender, face, armor or just choose a random selection!

https://youtu.be/HbWsxQNeFJk

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are almost at the end of our development and will be launching the game out of early access soon after we make sure that the game is as bug free as possible. We will continue to support the game with some new decorations at the end of the year for some halloween and christmas themes.

notes.title: Food Fight Easter Sale! Plus Game of Thrones-inspired skin & Magic Updates
notes.content:
[b]Easter Sale[/b]
We are having a 50% off for this week until end of easter Sunday! Our easter skin is still available to change the food to easter eggs!

https://youtu.be/67wQGwlwY3o

[b]GoT-inspired skin[/b]
We are also very excited about Game of Thrones being back for the last time and decided to make a skin inspired by them. On one side of the table, we have Team Dragon with dragon heads holding our magic balls. The other end we have Team Wolf with wolf heads. Oh and go sit on the Iron Throne if you like!

[b]Magic Upgrades[/b]
In addition to the forward blast and chair shield, we now have more magic balls available as well add to your arsenal in food fight damage:
1) Cannon Fire - spawn a turret for a few seconds to auto fire some food at the direction you point it at
2) Strawman Defender - spawn a moving strawman at your side of the table to fend of some food.
3) Matrix Time - for a few seconds any thrown food in front of you hand slows down as it comes nearer   
4) Revolving Guard - A spoon, fork and knife spins around you creating a barrier that may block food from hitting you

*Tips: store up to 4 magic balls in the wrist sockets before each food fight

Overall we got more assets to make stuff nicer generally. We will also be releasing a new map option soon where locomotion will become more important to the gameplay (hopefully end of the month) and food fight becomes a free-for-all battle mode.[b]Easter Sale[/b]

notes.title: Update 1: Locomotion, Magic Boost and Lunar New Year Skin
notes.content:
Hi everyone, hope it has been fun trying out IgKnight Food Fight.
It is still very much a work in progress as we are adding in more features.

[b]MULTIPACK Bundle Deals
[/b]
[i]For those who missed our launch discount, we have a special discounted 2-pack and 4-pack option that you can find in our website. Get a key for yourself and friends to play this food fight together![/i]

[url=http://igknightgames.com/igknight-food-fight/]IgKnight Food Fight Website[/url]

[b]UPDATES[/b]

In February, we will be starting to introduce new options to our menu (which you can turn on using the menu button) They are turned off by default but you can toggle them on. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ae5xquITpKU&feature=youtu.be

The features we will make available in this new update are:
1) Locomotion: (We will add more options in the future)
- Grip your right controller to move in the direction you are facing. 
- Grip your left controller to move in the opposite direction you are facing.

2) Magic Boost: After getting hit a couple of times, some transparent balls with an object in it will be floating around. Grab it and release it to unleash the magic inside. The current magic available are:
- Force Blast (Send all the food within a radius of the ball flying in the direction the cone object is pointing at)
- Chair (Create a chair to use as a shield)

3) Fire Food: Catch the food that is thrown at you to fire up the food for a extra fast throw! 

4) Lunar New Year Skin: The hall decoration and background music will be changed to fit the Lunar New Year Theme. The food in the food fight and winning confetti item will also change. Also try throwing some food into the Lion's mouth!

Our Lunar New Year Skin will be available until the 19th of February which is also the 15th day of Lunar New Year which Chinese celebrate the festival until. Check it out before it is gone!

4) Others: Hands animations are available now. Your hands close when you press the trigger.

Let us know what you guys think of these new features and what other stuff would you like to see in this game.
